meta.title: Event Photo Manifest
notes: 19 photos match event/adventure records already represented in the repository catalog.
One Snow Mountain Ranch Nordic/skijoring image remains intentionally unresolved because available metadata and visual evidence do not establish a unique date.
No duplicate race records were created during photo ingestion.
meta.assetPolicy: Repository assets are 480 px web previews because the connected GitHub binary writer requires inline binary transfer. A separate downloadable bundle contains renamed originals and 2000 px web-ready derivatives. All repository previews are auto-oriented and have EXIF/GPS stripped.
meta.integrity: repositoryBlobSha is the authoritative identifier for each committed preview.
